reviews.limitations: Snapshot covers verified publications available through 20 Oct 2026, 2:02:04 PM Jakarta, not the full future day. Policy/remarks, inflation, labor/wages, activity and off-calendar news were searched for all eight currencies. Several currencies have fewer than four verified distinct items; row gaps explain this. Direct retrieval failed for several pages; only sources whose indexed full release/report text or result table was available were retained, with access notes. Headline-only snippets were not used for actuals. Broader Swiss trade actuals remain unresolved. Schedules were scanned through 27 Oct plus the next policy decisions. Some data-release hours and policy press-conference stages could not be independently verified and remain date-only; this is not a complete speech/calendar inventory. S&P's official PDF returned 403; indexed publisher schedule and prior saved context were checked. GDT's live next-event listing conflicts with an older planner PDF; the live dated listing is used. NZ CPI hour unresolved. Publication hours absent from date-only news have not been invented. Directional additions are fundamental interpretations of the preserved information set, not measured intraday moves. Risk-appetite flow commentary is attributed. Source checks completed later than the original cutoff; no later outcomes are imported. No exact execution minute is claimed.
reviews.note: Requested directional addition to the saved 20 October news snapshot, appended as a new version. Original research cutoff 2026-10-20T07:02:04Z and all news/checkpoints remain preserved; this is not a full fresh news-table refresh. Directional interpretation was authored and sources checked later, using only evidence available by the original cutoff. Windows begin at that cutoff and end within the same Jakarta day; already-elapsed portions retain their original snapshot meaning. Top entries are ordered standalone currency judgments, not a pair scan or measured strength index. Older policy sources are explicitly Background and are not counted as 20 October news. Actual verification and saved clocks are retained. No OHLC, raw calendar changes, pins, alarms or trade-note changes.

reviews.limitations: Snapshot covers verified publications available through 20 Oct 2026, 2:02:04 PM Jakarta, not the full future day. Policy/remarks, inflation, labor/wages, activity and off-calendar news were searched for all eight currencies. Several currencies have fewer than four verified distinct items; row gaps explain this. Direct retrieval failed for several pages; only sources whose indexed full release/report text or result table was available were retained, with access notes. Headline-only snippets were not used for actuals. Broader Swiss trade actuals remain unresolved. Schedules were scanned through 27 Oct plus the next policy decisions. NZ CPI hour unresolved. Publication hours absent from date-only news have not been invented. Directional additions are fundamental interpretations of the preserved information set, not measured intraday moves. Risk-appetite flow commentary is attributed.
